description: Search live USAJOBS federal postings by keyword, location, agency, pay grade, schedule, clearance and hiring path, or read the full details of specific job links. No API key or login is required.

agency.description: Agency or department name, acronym or code, for example "NASA", "Department of the Navy" or "NV27". Comma-separate several values.
agency.title: Agency / Organization

department.description: Parent federal department name, acronym or code, for example "Department of Defense", "DOD" or "DD". Comma-separate several values.
department.title: Department

hiringPath.description: Filter by the audience the posting is open to.
hiringPath.title: Who May Apply

includeDetails.description: Fetch each posting's full announcement for duties, qualifications, education, salary range, remote/telework status and clearance. Turn off for a faster, lighter run.
includeDetails.title: Include Full Job Details

jobCategoryCode.description: Four-digit federal occupational series codes, comma-separated (for example "2210" for IT or "0343" for management analysis).
jobCategoryCode.title: Occupational Series Codes

jobType.description: Filter by appointment or job type.
jobType.title: Appointment Type

jobUrls.description: In Job Details mode, paste USAJOBS job links (https://www.usajobs.gov/job/123456789) or bare control numbers.
jobUrls.title: Job Links or IDs (Job Details mode)

keyword.description: Job title, skill or keyword to search for (for example "software engineer" or "data analyst").
keyword.title: Keyword

locationName.description: City, state or country to search in, for example "Washington, DC" or "Germany".
locationName.title: Location

maxItems.description: Maximum number of postings to return.
maxItems.title: Max Items

minSalary.description: Only return postings whose advertised starting salary is at least this amount.
minSalary.title: Minimum Salary (USD)

mode.description: Search federal vacancies, or read full details for job links you already have.
enumTitles: Get details for specific job links
mode.title: Mode

relocationAssistance.description: Only return postings that reimburse relocation expenses.
relocationAssistance.title: Relocation Assistance Only

schedule.description: Filter by the posting's work schedule.
schedule.title: Work Schedule

securityClearance.description: Filter by the clearance level a posting requires.
securityClearance.title: Security Clearance

travelPercentage.description: Filter by how much travel the posting requires.
travelPercentage.title: Travel Required

workSite.description: Filter for remote jobs, exclude remote jobs, or find telework-eligible jobs.
workSite.title: Work Site

title: USAJOBS Federal Vacancy & Pay Grade Finder Input
